news.title: RightNow Media — free for the Shiloh family
news.body: Shiloh now provides free RightNow Media accounts — a huge library of Bible studies and video teaching for every age. Register with the link below and start exploring today.

news.title: From the Pastor's Blog: Greetings
news.body: Greetings to all of our friends, neighbors, colleagues and co-laborers in the Lord's Work. I am Pastor Carl and we have created this blog so that I can share some of the wonderful and challenging thoughts and ideas that God has placed on my heart, as I exercise the privilege of leading God's church at Shiloh.
